jetbrains.releaseflow.a-breaking-change-: A breaking change: 1.2.3 → 2.0.0. On a 0.x package, major gives 1.0.0.
jetbrains.releaseflow.no-commit-releases: {names}: no commit releases it. The new tag points at HEAD, and the same code is published under a new version, with a GitHub Release and the assets.
jetbrains.releaseflow.hold-it-back-it-do: Hold it back: it does not release this time. A package that releases only because of it is held back too.
jetbrains.releaseflow.keep-the-bumps-as-: Keep the bumps as they are
jetbrains.releaseflow.change-its-bump-a-: Change its bump: a request, not an inference.
jetbrains.releaseflow.release-it-anyway-: Release it anyway: the same code under a new version. It creates a tag at HEAD, publishes to the registry, makes a GitHub Release and cannot be undone.
jetbrains.releaseflow.nothing-to-release: Nothing to release: a package releases when a commit since its last tag asks for it.
jetbrains.releaseflow.no-commit-releases: {it}: no commit releases it. Release… can release it anyway (the same code under a new version).
jetbrains.releaseflow.smith-printed-the-: smith printed the release plan in a form this plugin does not read. Update the plugin, or run smith release in a terminal.
jetbrains.releaseflow.this-is-what-a-rel: {title}: this is what a release would do now
jetbrains.releaseflow.nothing-is-publish: Nothing is published yet. Next you can hold packages back and change a bump. After that comes the last question.
jetbrains.releaseflow.tick-the-packages-: Tick the packages that must not release this time. Nothing ticked releases them all.
jetbrains.releaseflow.this-cannot-be-und: This cannot be undone. smith creates the tags, pushes them and publishes the packages to the registries. Undo does not revert it.
jetbrains.releaseflow.no-commit-releases: No commit releases anything now. You can release a package anyway: the same code under a new version. Tick none to release nothing.
No commit releases these packages. Tick one to release it anyway; tick none to release only what the plan lists.
jetbrains.releaseflow.release-a-package-: {title}: release a package without a releasing commit?
jetbrains.releaseflow.pick-a-package-to-: Pick a package to change its level, or keep them all.
jetbrains.releaseflow.a-package-releases: A package releases when a commit since its last tag asks for it.
jetbrains.releaseflow.show-the-release-p: Show the release preview: it says why nothing releases and what to do.
jetbrains.releaseflow.choose-a-package-t: Choose a package to release although no commit releases it. It creates a tag at HEAD, publishes, and cannot be undone.
